inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: imfundo yendalo malunga nokukhutshwa kwekhabhoni, umkhondo wekhabhoni, amacebiso ophila ngendlela esimeleyo, izinto ezinomdla kunye neendaba zendalo.

hero.titulo: Umkhwa ngamnye omncinci uthwalisa umhlaba umthwalo ongephi
hero.texto: ICARBONO CONSCIENTE AYIFANI NOLUHLAZA NOKUBA NGUYE UMNQOPHISO OKUDE — IYISAMBA SOKUKHETHA OKUQHELEKILEYO, OKUPHINDWA USUKU NGALUNYE: OKU UTYALAYO, INDLELA OHAMBA NGAYO, XESHA UCIMA UKHANYISO, APHO UPHOSA INKUNKUMA.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Ukukhutshwa kwekhabhoni kukhutshwa kwegesi efana neCO₂ emoyeni, ngokukodwa ngokutshiswa kwamafutha asemlotheni, ukugawulwa kwamahlathi, imveliso yezimboni kananjalo nothutho lwemihla ngemihla.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Igesi yendlu yenkukhu yenza umaleko obambe ubushushu emoyeni. Ngokwanda kokukhutshwa, uyakhula lo mphumela — nalonto ikhokelela kushushu kweplanethi nokutshintsha kwemozulu.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Yisixa esipheleleyo segesi yendlu yenkukhu esivelayo, ngokuthe ngqo okanye ngokungathanga ngqo, kwimisebenzi yomntu, inkampani okanye imveliso yemihla ngemihla.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Ikhabhoni engathathi cala ifuna ukulinganisa okanye ukuhlawula ukukhutshwa okuvelayo. Carbono consciente ibeka phambili ukukhetha okunciphisa impembelelo kwindalo ngaphambi kokucinga ngokuhlawula.

reciclagem.resumo: Hlula, phinda usebenzise, kwaye unike ubomi obutsha koko kuseleyo
reciclagem.item3: Thumela izinto ezinokuphindwa zisetyenziswe apho kufanelekile

fatos.fato1: Umthi omdala udonsa malunga ne-22 kg ye-CO₂ ngonyaka — yiyo ke lo nto ukuphinda kutyalwa amahlathi kungenye yeendlela eziqondileyo zokulungisa ukukhutshwa kwemifuthi.
fatos.fato2: Iilwandle zidonsa malunga nesahlulo sesine sawo wonke umoya we-CO₂ okhutshwa ngubume boluntu minyaka le minyaka, zisebenza njengelungisa elikhulu lemozulu yomhlaba.
fatos.fato3: Ukuphinda kusetyenziswe itoni enye yephepha kugcina imithi ekumalunga ne-17 kwaneenzuzo ezikhulu zamanzi kunye namandla xa kuthelekiswa nokuvelisa iphepha elitsha.
fatos.fato4: Ezothutho zinoxanduva kusahlulo sesine sokukhutshwa komoya we-CO₂ wehlabathi ohambelana namandla — ukutshintsha imoto ngebhayisekile okanye uthutho loluntu kwiindlela ezimfutshane kwenza umahluko wokwenyani.
fatos.fato5: I-Amazon inokuhlala kuyo malunga ne-10% yezinto zonke eziphilayo ezaziwayo emhlabeni, ikwagcina izigidigidi zetoni zekhabhoni ezityalweni zayo.
fatos.fato6: Iiplanga zelanga zasekhayeni zinokunciphisa unyawo lwekhabhoni lwendlu ngeetoni ze-CO₂ ngonyaka, kuxhomekeke kumxube wamandla asekuhlaleni.
fatos.fato7: Ukutya okunenyama ebomvu encinci kunokunciphisa unyawo lwekhabhoni lomntu ngokubonakalayo, ekubeni ukufuya iinkomo kuyenye yemisebenzi yolimo enokhutshwa kwemifuthi okukhulu.
fatos.fato8: Ukunyibilika kwomkhenkce welwandle e-Arctic kunciphisa amandla ehlabathi okubuyisela ukukhanya kwelanga esithubeni, oku kukhawulezisa ukufudumala — isiphumo esaziwa ngokuba kukubuyela kwe-albedo.
fatos.fato9: Iibhalbhu ze-LED zisebenzisa amandla aphantsi ngesahlulo esingangeepesenti 80 kunezibane zendalo, zihlale ixesha elide ngakumbi, zinciphisa kokubini ukukhutshwa kwemifuthi norhwebo.
fatos.fato10: Isivumelwano saseParis, esatyikitywa ngamazwe angaphezu kwama-200, sijolise ekunciphiseni ukufudumala komhlaba ukuba kube phantsi kwe-2°C ngaphezulu kwamanani angaphambi kweshishini.
fatos.fato11: Malunga nesahlulo sesithathu sokutya konke okuveliswayo ehlabathini kuyalahlwa — ukulahlwa kodwa kukhuphe inxalenye ebonakalayo yokukhutshwa kwemifuthi yegesi yefuthe emhlabeni.
fatos.fato12: Iiturbhini zomoya zanamhlanje zinakho ukuvelisa amandla aneleyo okuxhasa amawaka ezindlu, ngaphandle kokukhupha i-CO₂ ngexesha lokusebenza.
fatos.fato13: Umhlaba osempilweni ugcina ikhabhoni engakumbi kunazo zonke izityalo nomoya kunzulu kunikiwe kunye — ukusetyenziswa kolimo olubuyisela luncedisa ukugcina ikhabhoni emhlabeni.
fatos.fato14: Iindunduma zekorale, nangona zigubungela ngaphantsi kwe-1% yomhlaba welwandle, zixhasa malunga ne-25% yabo bonke ubomi balwandle obaziwayo — kananjalo zisemanzi ngokugqithisileyo kukufudumala kwamanzi.
fatos.fato15: Ukunciphisa inkutalo yamanzi afudumele ekhayeni (umzekelo, ukuhlamba ixesha elifutshane) kukwanciphisa ukukhutshwa kwemifuthi, kuba ukufudumeza amanzi kusebenzisa amandla.
fatos.fato16: Iimoto zombane, nangona sithatha ingqalelo kumveliso webhetri, zidla ngokukhupha i-CO₂ encinci ngobomi bazo bonke kunezweymoto ezisebenzisa uqhushululu, ingakumbi apho umbane uvela kwimithombo ecocekileyo.
fatos.fato17: Ukwenza izibulali-zinambuzane zokutya ekhayeni kunqanda ukuba zivelise imethane kwiindawo zokulahla inkunkuma — igesi yefuthe emhlabeni enamandla ngakumbi kune-CO₂ kwixesha elifutshane.
fatos.fato18: Amakhakhayi eGreenland ne-Antarctica, kuminyaka yamva nje, elahlekelwa ngemijondolo yezigidigidi zetoni zomkhenkce ngonyaka, oku kunegalelo ngqo kunyuko lomgangatho wolwandle.

globo.sem_dados_territorio: Akukho datha yokukhutshwa kweCO₂ ngomntu ngamnye ekhoyo kulo mmandla.
globo.fonte_estimativa: Uqikelelo lweCO₂ yamafutha asemlotheni ngomntu ngamnye (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, unyaka osisiseko 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: Umhlaba osebenzisanayo wokukhutshwa kwekhabhoni. Tsala ukujikeleza, skrola ukusondeza, cofa ilizwe ukubona idatha, kwaye ucofe kabini ukubeka umhlaba kwimo yokugqama.
globo.aria_decorativo: Umhlaba wokuhombisa ojikelezayo, obonisa ukufikelela komhlaba kwiprojekthi yeCarbono Consciente.
